description: This file contains a PHP class 'ImportViewStep2' which handles the display logic for step 2 of an import process in a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM-based application. It manages UI assignment, loading import mappings, and embedding JavaScript for client-side interactions.

classes.name: ImportViewStep2
classes.description: A view handler class for step 2 of the import process, responsible for rendering the UI, handling user interactions, and managing import mappings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the HTML template for step 2 of the import process.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for client-side interactions within the import step 2 view.
